en: Hasawi Lemon Exhibition (alternative name of the Hasawi Lomi Exhibition)
source: Durchkopplung of two already-verified elements: 'die Hasawi-Limette' (die) — Iyad's field investigation 2026-08-29, published /de/fruits/ card — plus the undisputed Duden headword 'Ausstellung' (feminine). Same precedent class as the batch's own 'die Al-Salam-Straße' / 'die Ain-Najm-Straße' (both status 'derived', judge-confirmed in de-ev-4, context.json termbase_terms_relevant).
note: Judge-confirmed final: status 'derived' correctly distinguishes this from an unwitnessed foreign proper name (e.g. 'Freej') — the gender comes from an unambiguous German generic noun, not a guess. Used once, in ev.lomi.intro, as the Arabic-authorised alternative name (English's second alt-name 'Al-Ahsa Lemon Festival' is correctly fenced out — the Arabic authority carries only one alternative name).
